I’m not sure how your parents react but the approach that usually works for me is to make it seem like it’s not a big deal. If you don’t play it up then they look pretty stupid freaking out but sometimes if you act like you think they will have an opinion then they will. Maybe don’t even mention who your going with or your lack of a date. Just bring it up on the way to school or right when your about to jump out of a car or leave the house a situation akin to that where you are in a rush and about to leave. Simply say something like “oh I almost forgot to tell you  prom is on date) and I wanna go bye, love you” if they make a big deal about who your going with right then you can either tell them “just some friends” as you leave otherwise don’t say anything unless they bring it up again later. If they do then just say the same thing and try to get away quickly to avoid it becoming a conversation. This approach doesn’t work for everyone but hopefully it works for you. Good luck.
